text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired -> Service: inference.prod.latency | Alert: p99 latency > 2.5s for 5m
pagerduty: Escalation: page sent to primary oncall (mira)
mira: acked. looking now. any quick context?
jason: also seeing spike on per-route dashboard, p95 steady, p99 jumping — probably tail issues. link: https://grafana.redwood/inference/prod?panel=latency (sharing)
alex: throwing this out — we had a model rollout yesterday, v2.0.3. Could be quantization path.
mira: good call. checking recent deploy metadata and node-level metrics.
incident-bot: Related alerts: request-errors up 0.2%, cpu on gpulb-12 spiky, autoscaler not scaling fast enough
sophia: customer-impact FYI: support queue has 3 mentions of slow responses for embeddings and generation since 09:12UTC, ticket #4567, #4568
mira: running quick tail traces on one of the slow request ids.
```
# curl to tracing service
curl -s "https://traces.redwood/trace?id=abc123" | jq '.spans[-1] | {service, duration_ms, tags}'
service: runtime-gpu-3
duration_ms: 3120
tags: ["kv-cache-miss","batch=1"]
```
jason: that trace shows a KV cache miss — single-token prefixes blowing up. batch sizes are small but tails affected.
alex: looking at autoscaler logs: saw a couple of OOM evictions yesterday around 02:00UTC on the pool that serves this model. might have reduced capacity headroom.
mira: can someone check capacity for pool "inference-prod-pool-a"?
jason: checking now — current replica count 8, desired 12 but HPA hasn't scaled due to missing metrics. kube-metrics-server throwing 404 in logs.
sophia: estimated customer impact: 1-2% request latency degradation but some timeouts for long sequences. notifying CS.
mira: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase pool replicas to 14 2) force fallback routing to lower-latency model variant v1.9 for heavy routes 3) open quick postmortem if rollout implicated.
alex: I'm ready to bump replicas, will run command in 2m unless objections.
mira: go ahead. coordinate with me before rollback.
alex: `kubectl scale deployment/inference-prod-pool-a --replicas=14 -n prod` -> submitted, pods coming up.
incident-bot: Deployment event: scaled inference-prod-pool-a to 14 (3 new pods booting)
jason: checking traces again — slight improvement in queuing but still some p99s at 1.8-2.1s. routing to v1.9 now enabled for route /v1/generate-heavy by feature flag.
sophia: CS update: let customers on critical plans know we have active mitigation and are seeing improved metrics.
mira: good. will monitor next 15m. if p99 < 1.5s and error rate normalizes we can close. current plan: stay on call until stable, then handoff.
jason: note for handoff: logs show kube-metrics-server 404s — infra should look after scale behavior tomorrow morning.
mira: handing to jason for next shift at 10:40UTC if still warming; I'm marking this thread with :white_check_mark: when resolved.
alex: thumbs on host health, GPU mem nominal, new pods healthy.
sophia: updated ticket #4567 with mitigation steps and ETA.
mira: thanks all — keeping this open. will post final impact summary once we have stable numbers.
(incident-bot): If no activity for 30m, auto-close reminder will post.
